test_stimuli.name: ch0_mid_scale
test_stimuli.derivation: stream bytes: [0x00, 0x7F, 0xFF]; high_byte=0x7F, low_byte=0xFF; raw = ((0x7F & 0x03) << 8) | 0xFF = (0x03 << 8) | 0xFF = 0x3FF = 1023; but expected 511? That's full scale. high_byte bits [1:0]=0x01, low_byte=0xFF; so stream = [0x00, 0x7F, 0xFF] gives high_byte=0x7F, low_byte=0xFF -> raw=1023. To get 511, need high_byte=0x01, low_byte=0xFF; stream = [0x00, 0x01, 0xFF]. Correcting mock_preload.
